title: Shorshe Ilish
summary: Shorshe ilish is hilsa fish cooked in a pungent mustard paste with mustard oil, green chillies and turmeric — a classic Bengali dish, especially in monsoon season.
steps: Marinate hilsa pieces with salt and turmeric
Grind mustard seeds with green chilli and a pinch of salt
Mix the paste with water, mustard oil and turmeric; add fish
Steam or simmer gently for 10–15 minutes; finish with raw mustard oil
